title: Answer a Steam invitation from the title screen
setup: Show the exact invitation, then let the player join the training room or dismiss the offer. [Steam invitation setup](/steam/listen-servers#invite-and-join)

title: Return to the title screen after a match
setup: Click Return to title to end the training session and show the title screen. [Game scope setup](/game-services#find-the-game-from-a-pause-menu)

title: Check the transport factory in a LAN test
setup: The test host logs when its provider creates a fresh ENet adapter. [Transport override setup](/game-services#override-the-lan-transport)

title: Award the training achievement
setup: Call `training_completed()` from the training objective's completion signal. The results screen reports whether Steam accepted the unlock request. [Steam achievement setup](/steam/client-services#unlock-an-achievement)
